The app's navigation is a single top-level "Main" nav with one link, Tickets (linked to a brand/home logo "Repair Desk"). Main screens: (1) a sign-in screen (email + password), (2) a Tickets list (#/tickets) showing tickets such as RD-1014 with Title, Customer, and Status columns, and (3) a Ticket detail screen (#/tickets/t14) reached by clicking a row, which shows a breadcrumb back to Tickets, the ticket reference and heading, customer/raised date, a Status badge (currently "Draft") with "Mark Ready" and "Archive ticket" actions, and a "Parts" region with a parts table (Name, Cost, Markup, Qty, Supplier, Price, Actions) plus "Add part", per-row "Edit"/"Delete", a note that price is calculated from cost and markup on save, and a Total (price × quantity) row. There is no separate global Parts screen — parts are managed within each ticket.
